detail_ld.description:
¿Eres un/a apasionado/a del derecho y los mercados financieros que sueña con dominar la IA para transformar la infraestructura bursátil?

En Bit2Me STX, no buscamos a alguien que solo gestione trámites o revise papeles; buscamos a una persona con ganas de crecer como Arquitecto/a Operativo y Regulatorio utilizando herramientas de IA Generativa. Somos el pilar de Valores del grupo Bit2Me (el primer exchange del mundo en obtener la licencia MiCA) y queremos que nos ayudes a construir el puente de confianza entre los mercados de capitales tradicionales y la tecnología DLT.

Si te obsesiona la regulación financiera, las nuevas tecnologías y quieres formarte con los mejores en el sector Fintech y Crypto-Securities, este es tu laboratorio.

Tu Misión: Crecer y Escalar el Impacto Regulatorio y Operativo con Tecnología

Como Intern en nuestro equipo de Legal, Compliance y Operaciones de Bit2Me STX, tu papel será fundamental. No estarás solo/a; colaborarás directamente con el equipo fundador y ejecutivos sénior procedentes de empresas líderes financieras en pleno lanzamiento de la Bolsa de Valores en blockchain.

¿En qué colaborarás con nosotros? (El "CÓMO"):

Onboarding de Clientes y Emisores: Apoyarás la verificación de KYC/AML, la revisión de documentación y el análisis de completitud de expedientes con el máximo rigor.

Expedientes de Admisión y Gobierno Corporativo: Ayudarás a preparar los expedientes de admisión de emisores y los materiales para el comité de admisiones y el consejo de administración.

Relaciones Regulatorias y Compliance: Colaborarás en registros, archivos y correspondencia regulatoria oficial con la CNMV y otras autoridades supervisoras.

Excelencia Operativa: Mantendrás checklists operativos, registros y documentación de procesos clave para el lanzamiento inminente de la bolsa.

Gestión Documental y Societaria: Mantendrás organizados y al día los contratos, políticas internas y documentación societaria.

Apoyo a Business Development: Colaborarás en el seguimiento del pipeline de emisores, análisis de mercado y preparación de materiales de presentación.

Automatización con IA: Te formarás en el uso de herramientas de IA (como ChatGPT, Claude o Gemini) y Excel para automatizar tareas repetitivas y elevar la eficiencia operativa.

detail_ld.title: Enterprise Security Engineer
detail_ld.description:
About Coinswitch

CoinSwitch breaks down the complexities in Crypto, empowering the everyday Indian to make informed investment decisions on a simple and trusted platform. When we started up, Crypto was a field reserved for specialists. Today, over 20 million users trust CoinSwitch to learn, purchase and invest in Crypto. That makes us India’s largest crypto app.

On CoinSwitch, users can invest in Crypto with a few simple taps, either as a one-time purchase or in regular intervals through an SIP. But simplicity is not a substitute for informed decisions. A CoinSwitch user spends 27 minutes on our app—to learn about Crypto and Web3 through our educational content and understand the market sentiments through CRE8, the Crypto Rupee Index.

But we are just getting started. CoinSwitch not only plans to double down on making Crypto accessible to everyone but is on track to become the one-stop wealth-tech destination for every Indian.
For more information about CoinSwitch, find additional resources here: https://linktr.ee/coinswitchcareers
 

About the Role

We’re hiring an Enterprise Security Engineer to design, implement, and operate security controls across endpoints, networks, application and cloud environments.

What You’ll Do

  • Implement and manage endpoint & network security controls

  • Configure and operate SIEM, EDR/XDR, DLP & Email Security solutions

  • Monitor security events and support incident detection & response

  • Integrate logs from systems into SIEM and build detection use cases

  • Manage vulnerability scanning and remediation tracking

  • Automate security workflows using scripts / APIs where possible

  • Work with IT teams to harden systems (OS, servers, applications)

What We’re Looking For

Technical Skills (Must-Have)

  • Strong hands-on experience with:

    • SIEM / log analysis

    • EDR / endpoint security

    • Vulnerability management

  • Understanding of:

    • Networking basics (TCP/IP, firewalls, VPNs)

    • OS security (Windows/Linux/MacOS hardening)

  • Ability to:

    • Investigate alerts and identify root cause

    • Work with logs and security telemetry

  • Comfortable with:

    • Scripting (Python / Bash / PowerShell – basic to intermediate)

    • Automating repetitive security tasks

  • Basic understanding of cloud & application security (AWS/GCP preferred; OWASP Top 10)

Soft Skills

  • Problem-solving mindset

  • Ability to work in fast-paced security environments

  • Strong collaboration with IT, DevOps, and SOC teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience in SOC / Security Operations

  • Exposure to threat detection frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK)

  • Basic knowledge of compliance (ISO 27001, SEBI CSCRF, Data Privacy, SOC2)

  • Leveraging AI tools for productivity and work efficiency

  • Certifications: CompTIA Security+, CEH, or equivalent

 

Life at CoinSwitch

We take great pride in what we do, and are committed to our mission. And we have a lot of fun while at it!

Here’s how we do things at CoinSwitch:

  • Customer-first: That’s the North Star. Everything we do is to make our users’ investment experience better and simplified.

  • Ownership: We don’t sport lab coats, but we experiment—a lot. And we take ownership. We even have a catchphrase for this: Think big, fail fast, and build better.

  • Data-driven: The source of truth. Simple as that.

  • Fun: PS5, anyone? Or do you prefer Foosball? Or perhaps Carrom? And yes, our HR team has a whole list of activities: Disco nights, off-sites, gift boxes, and more!

 

Speaking of lists, the perks and benefits are so extensive, this space isn’t enough. Here are a few:

  • Parenthood: Up to 8 months of Maternity leave and 1 month of Paternity leave

  • Gender Reassignment Surgery: Be the best version of you! We’ll support you and reimburse your medical bill.

 

Disclaimer: We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

Qualifications

About the Role: 

We are looking for an Influencer Operations Executive to own the operational, reporting, and compliance functions of our influencer marketing business. This role requires someone who is highly analytical, process-driven, and comfortable working across Business, Finance, and Compliance teams. The ideal candidate should be able to manage large datasets, build dashboards, maintain audit-ready documentation, and ensure smooth execution of influencer campaigns.
 
What You Will Do: 

Data Analytics & Reporting
  • Own daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reporting for influencer campaigns and business performance.
  • Build and maintain dashboards using Tableau, Redash, and Databricks to track key business metrics.
  • Analyze campaign, creator, and operational data to generate actionable business insights.
  • Write SQL queries to extract, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
  • Automate recurring reports and improve reporting efficiency.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reporting hygiene across all operational workflows.
Finance & Compliance Operations
  • Coordinate with the Finance team to manage creator invoices, payment requests, reconciliations, and payout tracking.
  • Work closely with the Compliance and Legal teams to ensure contracts, KYC documents, approvals, and campaign documentation are complete.
  • Maintain proper audit trails and documentation for every influencer partnership.
  • Ensure operational processes comply with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify discrepancies and resolve finance and compliance issues in a timely manner.
Cross-functional Operations
  • Act as the operational bridge between Business, Finance, Compliance, Marketing, and Legal teams.
  • Track campaign timelines, deliverables, approvals, and operational milestones.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for influencer operations.
  • Identify process gaps and implement workflow improvements through automation and better reporting.
  • Support leadership with operational insights and business performance reports.
What You Should Have: 
  • Proficient in SQL for data extraction, validation, and analysis.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, Power Query, and advanced formulas.
  • Hands-on experience with Redash, Databricks, and Tableau for data analysis, dashboard creation, and business reporting.
  • Strong experience creating interactive Tableau dashboards and KPI reports.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with large datasets.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination skills.
  • High attention to detail with a strong focus on documentation, audit readiness, and process compliance.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in Operations, Business Analytics, MIS, Influencer Operations, or a similar role.
  • Experience working with Finance, Compliance, or Audit teams.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems and workflow automation tools is an added advantage.
Success Metrics
  • Accurate and timely MIS reporting.
  • Zero audit or compliance gaps across influencer operations.
  • Timely creator payouts and invoice processing.
  • High data accuracy across dashboards and reports.
  • Improved operational efficiency through automation and process improvements.

detail_ld.description:
About the Company

At Delta, we are reimagining and rebuilding the financial system. Join our team to make a positive impact on the future of finance.

🎯 Mission Driven: Re-imagine and rebuild the future of finance.

💡 Most innovative cryptocurrency derivatives exchange. With a daily traded volume of ~$ 10 billion, and increasing. Delta is bigger than all the Indian crypto exchanges combined.

📈 Offer the widest range of derivative products and have been serving traders all over the globe since 2018 and growing fast.

💪🏻 The founding team is comprised of IIT and ISB graduates. Business co-founders have previously worked with Citibank, UBS and GIC; and our tech co-founder is a serial entrepreneur who previously co-founded TinyOwl and Housing.com.

💰 Funded by top crypto funds (Sino Global Capital, CoinFund, Gumi Cryptos) and crypto projects (Aave and Kyber Network).

Senior QA Engineer - AI

🎯 Role Overview

Delta operates three AI products used by live traders: a customer support chatbot, an API Copilot that generates and executes trading scripts, and an MCP server. This role owns the quality of those products and is responsible for measuring it objectively.

Testing probabilistic systems differs fundamentally from testing deterministic ones. The same input produces different output on every run, an incorrect answer can be entirely fluent, and a prompt change in one flow can degrade another without any visible signal. The core of this role is establishing what correct means for these systems, building the datasets and scoring that measure it, and operating the release gate that prevents a regression from reaching customers.

This is an emerging discipline with no established playbook. We are defining the methodology as we build it, and the role carries a high degree of autonomy and ownership.

🔬 What Sets This Role Apart

Most QA roles that mention AI mean using AI to do testing faster: generating test cases from a PRD, healing flaky selectors, exploring an app with an agent. Those are useful and we do them.

This role is the other thing. The system under test is itself an AI, and the hard problem is deciding whether its output is correct when the same question produces a different answer every time and a wrong answer reads as convincingly as a right one. That means building evaluation datasets, defining what correct looks like, scoring against it, and defending a number that decides whether a release ships.

If you have spent time on the second problem, this role is built for you.

🛠 Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain golden datasets for our AI products, trace mined from production or generated, and verified against a documented source of truth.
  • Design layered scoring for AI outputs: deterministic rules where behaviour can be asserted, and model-graded evaluation where it cannot.
  • Manage evaluation runs end to end: schedule and execute them against release candidates, compare results against prior baselines, and triage failures into product defects, incorrect expectations, and platform issues.
  • Own and operate the release gate that determines whether a prompt or model change is approved for production.
  • Identify failure modes ahead of customers, including hallucination, incorrect tool selection, loss of context across conversation turns, and PII exposure.
  • Investigate production traces to distinguish retrieval failures from generation failures from tool failures.
  • Convert findings into actionable engineering evidence and into permanent regression coverage.
  • Define and report quality metrics for AI surfaces, and drive improvement against them.

✅ Requirements

Non-negotiable

  • At least 1 year owning quality for AI products in a lead or primary-owner capacity. This includes chatbots and conversational assistants, code or content generation products, and agentic systems. You should have worked directly with prompts, tool and function schemas, and model behaviour, rather than testing around them.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building or operating an evaluation harness for an AI system, whether in-house or using a framework such as DeepEval, RAGAS or Promptfoo. You should be able to describe what the harness measured, the results it produced, and the decisions those results informed.

Also required

  • 4-6 years of QA / SDET experience.
  • Working proficiency in Python. Our evaluation platform, trace analysis and internal tooling are Python-based.
  • Ability to analyse traces and tool calls, using observability tooling such as Opik, Langfuse or LangSmith or an equivalent, to determine root cause rather than reporting the symptom.
  • Strong API testing experience. The majority of the surface under test is API-level.
  • Sufficient engineering ability to build your own tooling and automation.
  • Clear written communication. Findings must be documented in a form engineering can act on directly.

Bonus

  • Experience with trading or exchange platforms, including familiarity with futures and options, crypto derivatives, margin, or settlement flows. Domain knowledge can be picked up on the job, but arriving with it shortens the ramp considerably.

🚀 Why Join Us?

  • Play a pivotal role in shaping the regulatory landscape for digital assets and Web3 in India.
  • Work directly with founders and senior leadership on high-impact strategic initiatives.
  • Be part of a mission-driven, fast-growing organisation at the forefront of financial innovation.
  • Competitive compensation, leadership exposure, and significant growth opportunities.

About Delta Exchange

With enterprise-grade security, deep liquidity, and an institutional-grade platform, Delta Exchange serves both retail and institutional clients, accelerating the evolution of the global cryptocurrency financial system.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a highly analytical and technically minded Risk Manager to join our Risk & Clearing team at Delta Exchange. You will be the primary owner of our exchange’s margin ecosystem, ensuring that our collateral requirements are balanced between capital efficiency

for traders and systemic safety for the platform. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of derivatives market structures, a data-driven

approach to liquidation analysis, and the ability to bridge the gap between complex financial risk and product development.

Core Responsibilities:

1. Margin Methodology & Oversight

● Own and optimize margin calculations across all supported modes, including Isolated, Cross, and Portfolio Margin.

● Develop and refine risk parameters (maintenance margin, initial margin, leverage tiers, position limits, and haircut models) to ensure the exchange is robust against extreme market volatility.

● Conduct stress testing and back-testing on margin models to ensure they withstand “black swan” events.

2. Liquidation & Negative Equity Analysis

  • ● Perform post-mortem analysis on trader liquidations to identify patterns of failure.
  • ● Investigate cases of negative equity (socialized losses/ADL) to determine why margin was insufficient and recommend adjustments to the insurance fund or liquidation engine logic.
  • ● Review mark price, index, and funding mechanisms to make sure they are fair and resistant to manipulation.

3. Product & Technical Collaboration

  • ● Tech Liaison: Partner with the engineering team to design and build real-time Risk Dashboards that monitor exchange-wide health, leverage ratios, and margin utilization.
  • ● Translate complex risk requirements into technical specifications for the development of automated risk-mitigation tools.

4. Trader Experience & Market Microstructure

  • ● Collaborate with the Customer Experience (CX)/Audit team to investigate trader complaints regarding high slippage or liquidity constraints.
  • ● Analyze order book depth and execution quality to understand how liquidity gaps contribute to liquidation cascades.
  • ● Monitor user activity for patterns that profit at the exchange’s expense (e.g., funding arbitrage, expiry manipulation, spread capture) and help build surveillance to catch them.

5. Market-Making Risk

  • ● Understanding of the market-making book, including inventory, Greeks exposure, hedge positions, and P&L.
  • ● Own and tune risk alerts for the desk, keeping thresholds sharp and false alarms low.
  • ● Lead incident analysis on pricing and quoting failures (stale order books, bad reference IVs, near-expiry illiquidity) and drive fixes into production.

Qualifications & Skills

● Experience: 2–5 years in Risk Management, Quantitative Analysis, Trading, or Operations within a Crypto Exchange, Market Maker, FinTech, or Traditional Derivatives Clearinghouse (CCP).

● Deep Domain Knowledge: Strong grasp of perpetual swaps, futures, and options, and the mechanics of auto-deleveraging (ADL).

● Market-Making Knowledge: Understanding of options Greeks, volatility surfaces, inventory risk, and hedging.

● Technical Proficiency: Ability to work with SQL for data extraction and Python/R for quantitative modeling. Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Grafana, or Looker) is a plus.

● Problem Solving: A “detective” mindset, you enjoy digging into trade logs to find out exactly why a liquidation or a quote went wrong.

● Communication: Ability to explain complex margin mechanics to non-technical stakeholders and customers.

Build the Cloud Data Platform

  • Lead the transition from batch-oriented systems to a scalable AWS-based streaming architecture

  • Design and implement real-time data replication pipelines across MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Amazon Redshift for core products hosted in the cloud

  • Develop AI-powered dashboards and analytics experiences: natural-language querying, automated insight generation, and LLM-driven reporting layers

  • Apply prompt engineering and LLM API integration (Anthropic/Claude API or similar) to automate repetitive data engineering tasks such as pipeline scaffolding, schema documentation, data quality checks, and runbook generation

Design and Model the Data Warehouse

  • Migrate and optimize OLAP workloads to cloud warehouses, tuning relentlessly for performance, scalability, and cost at multi-terabyte scale

Move Data Reliably at Scale

  • Build and operate ETL/ELT and Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines that replicate and transform data reliably across heterogeneous systems

  • Orchestrate automated, observable, reproducible workflows for daily data transformation and delivery (Airflow, Step Functions, or similar)

  • Hold the line on data integrity, accuracy, and timely delivery through validation tooling and post-load quality checks

Ensure Operational Reliability

  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines with a focus on uptime and SLA compliance

  • Maintain high standards of data quality, validation, lineage, and governance

  • Continuously optimize pipelines for performance and cost, and keep SOPs, runbooks, and operational workflows current with AI-assisted documentation

Power Analytics, BI and AI

  • Partner with BI, analytics, product, and business teams to translate business requirements into robust data models and real-time reporting layers

  • Deliver dashboards and reporting (Metabase, Tableau, Power BI) that give the firm visibility into revenue, financial, and customer-experience metrics, progressively enhanced with AI-driven features

  • Prepare clean, governed datasets and feature sources that make AI and machine-learning use cases possible

Lead, Own, Deliver

  • Own pipelines end to end, from ingestion through transformation, deployment, monitoring, and incident response, with no hand-offs and no gaps

  • Operate independently in a fast-moving environment, owning outcomes rather than tasks

  • Deep experience with cloud data platforms, including AWS (primary) and Snowflake and/or Google Cloud, plus strong command of PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Amazon Redshift

Your X-Factor

  • You treat data quality and business impact as one thought, not competing priorities. Every pipeline you build is both trustworthy and tied to a decision that matters.

As our Senior Database Reliability Engineer, you’ll combine hands-on database engineering with technical leadership, driving performance, recoverability, and operational excellence across our data tier. You’ll establish engineering standards, mentor junior engineers, lead critical database incidents, and work closely with engineering and business leaders to ensure our data infrastructure remains reliable, secure, and ready to scale.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Database Performance & Architecture

  • Own query performance and latency across Aurora MySQL and PostgreSQL through execution-plan analysis, indexing strategies, and database statistics optimization.

  • Design and implement partitioning, sharding, and data lifecycle strategies for high-volume tables.

  • Identify and remove unused or redundant indexes to improve database efficiency.

  • Build zero-downtime archiving pipelines using S3, Parquet, and Athena while keeping seven years of compliance data queryable.

Reliability, Recovery & Incident Management

  • Own disaster recovery across the data tier, including Aurora Global Database, cross-region replication, and failover automation.

  • Define, test, and track recovery time objectives (RTO) and recovery point objectives (RPO) through regular disaster recovery drills.

  • Maintain replication, backup, and point-in-time recovery (PITR) health, including routine restore testing.

  • Lead data-tier incidents as incident commander, coordinate response efforts, make informed recovery trade-offs, and drive blameless root-cause analyses.

Safe Database Changes & Infrastructure

  • Lead safe schema and data migrations on live tables using online DDL, expand-contract patterns, and AWS DMS/CDC where appropriate.

  • Own caching reliability across ElastiCache/Redis, including invalidation strategies, TTL hygiene, and failure handling.

  • Manage database configuration and infrastructure as code using Terraform.

  • Define and monitor data-tier SLIs and SLOs, building effective observability and alerting with Datadog or similar tools.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Establish standards for schema reviews, migration safety, database access control, and change governance.

  • Mentor and coach junior database reliability engineers, review their work, and help them develop sound technical judgment.

  • Partner with application engineering, data engineering, and product leaders to identify risks arising from query patterns and schema design.

  • Own the data-tier roadmap and communicate priorities, risks, and trade-offs clearly to engineering leadership and the CTO.

  • Contribute to hiring, capacity planning, and the continued development of our database reliability function.

What You Bring

  • 8–10 years in database engineering, database reliability engineering, or site reliability engineering, including several years owning production databases at multi-terabyte scale.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of MySQL and PostgreSQL; experience with Aurora/RDS is strongly preferred.

  • Daily experience using agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Windsurf beyond basic prompts and autocomplete. You can configure project-level instructions and rules files, delegate tasks to AI agents, and integrate AI into code reviews while independently validating its outputs.

  • Production experience with partitioning, sharding, and archiving large tables.

  • Direct experience executing database failovers or recovery drills, with measured RTO/RPO targets.

  • A methodical approach to diagnosing issues before making changes, validating solutions on replicas, and protecting production data.

  • Proficiency in Python or Bash scripting, Terraform, and infrastructure automation.

  • Experience with Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, or comparable monitoring and alerting tools.

  • Experience mentoring engineers, leading production incidents, and making sound decisions while remaining hands-on.

  • Ability to explain technical risks, recovery trade-offs, and database priorities to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

NEXT Ventures is a global fintech group operating FundedNext (proprietary trading) and FNmarkets (CFD brokerage), with teams across Malaysia, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Cyprus, and Dubai. We build products for traders worldwide, and we invest in our people so they can keep pace with an industry that moves fast.

YOUR ROLE IN OUR MISSION

As an L&D Specialist within People & Culture, you will design and deliver the learning experiences that help our employees perform at a high level. You will own the course production lifecycle: identifying learning needs with internal stakeholders, then designing, building, and publishing courses on our LMS. You will also lead onboarding and skill-based training for new and existing employees. You will manage multiple production tracks at once and drive learning initiatives forward with minimal supervision.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

  • Train and evaluate: Deliver in-person, online, and hybrid onboarding and skill-based training across technical and non-technical tracks, and run post-training evaluations on engagement, assessment performance, and program effectiveness.

  • Build courses: Design, build, and publish self-paced LMS courses covering technical, non-technical, trading industry, and product-specific needs, meeting quality standards and release timelines.

  • Collaborate: Work with teams across the business to identify learning needs, gather subject matter expertise, and facilitate structured learning initiatives.

  • Engage learners: Plan and run micro-learning campaigns through internal channels, from content development and audience targeting to scheduling and post-campaign reporting.

  • Measure outcomes: Develop and maintain assessments tied to learning programs, track completion and pass rates, and report outcomes to the L&D Manager.

  • Stay ahead: Review L&D trends and practices across industries and propose initiatives we can adapt and implement.

WHAT YOU BRING

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Business, Communication, or a related field (required).

  • Master's or postgraduate qualification in Learning & Development, HRD, or Instructional Design (preferred).

  • Instructional design, LMS administration, or a relevant L&D certification such as ATD or CPTD (preferred).

  • Experience - 1-2+ years in an L&D, training, or instructional design role.

  • Hands-on experience in course design and production, LMS management, training delivery, and stakeholder or vendor coordination.

  • Individual contributor role; no supervisory experience required.

Skills & Competencies

  • Instructional design: Structures learning content clearly, writes measurable learning outcomes, and applies adult learning principles.

  • Content research & synthesis: Distills complex information from stakeholders or external sources into concise, learner-ready material.

  • Presentation & public speaking: Delivers sessions, workshops, and briefings confidently to diverse audiences, in person and virtually.

  • LMS proficiency: Comfortable building, publishing, and managing learners in an LMS.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Engages stakeholders across departments, facilitates knowledge-gathering sessions, and builds relationships that drive learning outcomes.

  • Project & task management: Manages concurrent workstreams with clear ownership and tracks progress using project management tools.

  • Communication: Writes clearly and professionally; communicates proactively on status, blockers, and decisions.

X-FACTOR

  • AI tool literacy: You actively use AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or equivalents to accelerate research, content drafting, and course development.

  • You take initiative, keep several production tracks moving, and don't wait to be told what to do next.

YOUR JOURNEY

You will start by learning our products, the trading industry, and our existing learning programs, then take ownership of course production and training delivery. Over time, you will shape the L&D roadmap through the trends and initiatives you bring to the team, working closely with the L&D Manager and SMEs across departments.

detail_ld.title: Sr Engineer, IAM
detail_ld.description:
About the role –

As a Senior IAM Engineer, you will be a key member of the Enterprise IT organization, serving as a senior hands-on engineer responsible for the design, implementation, and operation of our enterprise-wide Identity and Access Management program.

The role will be responsible for engineering and delivering IAM solutions across Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Identity Providers (IdP/SSO), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and directory services. You will help bring together a complex, distributed identity environment, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP/OpenLDAP, SaaS applications, and enterprise platforms, into secure, scalable, automated, and supported identity workflows. The responsibilities include building automation, API-driven integrations, and lifecycle provisioning workflows; serving as a senior technical authority for architecture decisions and escalated engineering issues; driving integration across platforms such as Dayforce, M365, and ServiceNow; providing technical mentorship to other engineers; and collaborating with security, IT, HR, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into engineering deliverables.

We are seeking a well-rounded IAM engineer with strong identity fundamentals, broad integration experience, and the ability to apply those skills across evolving technologies. The successful candidate will have deep expertise in enterprise IAM platforms and protocols and will be comfortable assessing existing identity environments, defining target-state architecture, designing practical integration patterns, building automation, and operationalizing solutions through documentation, monitoring, support processes, and continuous improvement.  

What will you do:

  • Design, build, and deliver IAM engineering solutions including IGA, IdP/SSO, PAM, and directory services implementations.
  • Assess and help rationalize complex identity environments, including distributed Active Directory domains, Entra ID, LDAP/OpenLDAP deployments, application directories, and legacy identity integrations.
  • Develop target-state identity architectures and integration patterns that support cohesive joiner-mover-leaver lifecycle processes, secure access, data quality, and operational scalability.
  • Configure and support IGA capabilities such as identity profiles, authoritative sources, account correlation, attribute mappings, transforms, lifecycle states, sources/connectors, access profiles, roles, entitlements, access requests, approvals, certifications, and separation-of-duties controls.
  • Design, implement, and troubleshoot lifecycle provisioning and deprovisioning workflows across HR systems, directories, SaaS applications, databases, collaboration platforms, and IT service-management tools.
  • Develop, test, and deploy identity automation, API-driven integrations, and lifecycle provisioning workflows
  • Build and maintain IAM configuration promotion and development workflows, including source control, peer review, testing, release management, and platform-specific tooling such as SailPoint Configuration Hub, SP-Config, SDKs, or equivalent tools.
  • Design and maintain RBAC models, including role discovery, role design, entitlement mapping, access-profile design, role lifecycle management, and ongoing troubleshooting of access outcomes.
  • Configure and support IdP/SSO integrations using SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SCIM, and, where needed, WS-Federation and LDAP-based authentication patterns.
  • Engineer and support PAM capabilities, including privileged account onboarding, reconciliation, password rotation, verification, decommissioning, safe/vault access controls, approval workflows, least-privilege access, and separation of duties.
  • Integrate PAM platforms with Active Directory/LDAP, MFA, ticketing platforms, SIEM tools, cloud services, CI/CD pipelines, and identity governance solutions.
  • Automate privileged-account onboarding, reporting, health checks, credential operations, and operational tasks through PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, and related tooling.
  • Serve as a hands-on senior technical resource for complex architecture decisions, design reviews, and escalated engineering issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve identity-related issues involving aggregation, provisioning, correlation, authentication, SSO, MFA, directory synchronization, access requests, certifications, privileged credential rotation, session access, and connector or platform health.
  • Support SLAs, incident response, and root-cause analysis for IAM infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain engineering runbooks, documentation standards, and disaster recovery procedures for identity systems.
  • Champion automation-first approaches to reduce manual effort across access provisioning, certification, and onboarding workflows.
  • Provide technical guidance, code review, and mentorship to other engineers on the IAM team.
  • Partner with security, IT, HR, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into engineering deliverables.

What you will need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in IAM engineering.
  • Hands-on expertise with enterprise IAM platforms across IGA, IdP/SSO (e.g., Okta, Entra ID), PAM, directory services, lifecycle management, and access governance.
  • Strong understanding of IAM fundamentals, including authentication, authorization, RBAC, ABAC concepts, least privilege, separation of duties, access reviews, joiner-mover-leaver processes, identity data management, and privileged access controls.
  • Experience implementing or supporting an IGA platform, preferably SailPoint Identity Security Cloud or a comparable enterprise IGA solution.
  • Experience with IGA capabilities such as authoritative-source integration, account aggregation, correlation, identity profiles, attribute mappings, provisioning, access requests, approvals, certifications, access profiles, roles, entitlements, and lifecycle workflows.
  • Strong knowledge of standards and protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML 2.0, and SCIM.
  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting SSO, provisioning, MFA, directory synchronization, conditional/adaptive access controls, and application integrations in platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or equivalent IdPs.
  • Experience with a PAM platform, preferably CyberArk or an equivalent enterprise solution, including privileged-account lifecycle management, safe/vault administration, platform and policy configuration, credential rotation, reconciliation, and session management.
  • Proven experience building REST API-driven identity integrations and lifecycle automation using Python, PowerShell, Java, or similar languages in orchestration platformes such as Okta Workflows, Gitlab, Jenkins or similar.
  • Experience using APIs, scripting, and automation to manage IAM configurations, perform reporting, conduct health checks, and reduce operational overhead.
  • Experience with directory services administration and governance, including Active Directory, OpenLDAP, and cloud-based IdPs.
  • Solid understanding of identity data management, including attribute normalization, identity matching and correlation, duplicate identity resolution, data-quality remediation and database connectivity concepts (e.g., PostgreSQL, JDBC/ODBC).
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, deliver under pressure, and lead complex technical workstreams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences.

What would be nice to have:

  • Direct experience with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, including tenants, identity profiles, transforms, sources, workflows, lifecycle states, access governance, APIs, Configuration Hub, SP-Config, SDKs, or related development tooling.
  • Direct experience with CyberArk administration, including Digital Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, safes, platforms, account management, privileged sessions, and integrations.
  • Direct experience with Okta administration, including Universal Directory, Lifecycle Management, group rules, application integrations, MFA, sign-on policies, Okta Workflows, APIs, Terraform, and SCIM provisioning.
  • Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, etc.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust principles and their application to identity and access controls.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or vendor-specific IAM credentials (e.g., Okta Certified Professional).

 

Company benefits:

  • Competitive salary, annual performance-based bonus, and stock grant awards
  • 401(k) retirement plan with competitive company match
  • Excellent health and wellness benefits, including medical, dental, and vision benefits. 100% employer-paid medical premiums, with generous employer contributions to dental & vision plans as well.
  • Wellness screening and assessments, health coaches, and counseling services through an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid parental leave (up to 16 weeks paid parental leave for eligible employees)

  • Education reimbursement and professional development opportunities

detail_ld.description:
■業務内容
マネックス・ラボが提供している、以下の各種既存サービスの保守開発のプロジェクトマネジメントをお任せいたします。

＜具体的な業務内容＞
・既存のWebサービス/アプリの機能改修やUI改善のプロジェクトリード
・マネックス証券アプリを中心としたモバイルアプリの開発
・案件のスケジュール管理、成果物レビュー、技術的課題の解決支援
・関係部門や協力会社との調整、リリース後の保守運用
・お客様の資産形成をサポートするサービスの新規企画

＜主なプロジェクト＞
1）マネックス証券アプリ開発
マネックス証券の主力チャネルの一つであるスマートフォンアプリにおいて、投資初心者からライト・ミドルユーザー層まで、幅広いお客様がスムーズにお取引いただける体験の実現を目指します。
スマホアプリとして必要な機能の企画・開発を早いペースで繰り返し、継続的な改善を推進します。

2）ドコモ協業案件：投資初心者向けアプリ開発
ドコモと投資初心者向けサービスをリリース後、スピード感をもって継続改善し「より良いものに育てる」ことがミッションです。
複数の改善を並行で進めるため、アジャイルに近い形でのサービス発展を推進します。

3）Web資産形成ツール開発（Monex Labs Tools）
お客様の資産形成を支える既存ツール群（資産可視化・分析等）を、継続的に改善／拡張していきます。
UI/UX改善、機能追加、データ活用などを通じて、日常的に使われるプロダクトへ磨き込みます。
　例）
　└ 資産推移を振り返ることができる「MONEX VIEW」
　└ ポートフォリオ分析ツール「MONEX VISION」
　└ 投資実績の可視化ができる「MONEX 投資力診断」

そこで今回、新たにインフラエンジニアを募集します。既存システムの安定稼働を支えるだけでなく、モダナイズや自動化、セキュリティ強化といった取り組みに主体的に関わり、次の時代の証券システムを共に創り上げていただきます。


■仕事内容

意見やアイデアを自由に発信できる風通しの良い環境で、エンジニア一人ひとりに大きな裁量があります。
新技術の導入や業務改善を自ら主導し、積極的に取り組むことが可能です。

＜ポジションの魅力＞

オンプレミスとクラウドが共存するシステム環境で、インフラからアプリ連携まで幅広い技術に携わることができます。
証券業界の専門知識も自然と身につくため、IT×金融のスキルを磨きたい方に最適なポジションです。

クラウドへの移行を視野に入れた新システムの構想・設計が進行中です。

・経営に近い立場で、変革と成長を支える経理へ
新商品・新サービスを次々と展開する成長環境の中で、経理部門も経営判断を支える情報提供や課題解決を通じて、事業拡大に直接貢献することができます。

既存のやり方を踏襲するだけでなく、「どう分担すべきか」「どう仕組み化するか」といった業務改善・再設計に主体的に関与できます。

・大口IFA法人対応を含む、事業インパクトの大きい業務
事業全体に占める比重の大きいIFA法人を担当する機会もあり、自身の取り組みが事業の安定運営・成長に直結する手触りを得られます。

・個人ノルマに偏らない、長期的な関係構築に集中できる環境
チームとしての目標はありますが、個人単位での数字コミットメントを過度に求めるカルチャーはありません。短期的な数字に追われず、IFA法人との信頼関係の深化や、安定運営に向けた仕組みづくりに注力できます。

detail_ld.title: Finance Controller (CA)
detail_ld.description:
About Mudrex

Mudrex is India's leading crypto investment platform, backed by Y Combinator, Nexus Venture Partners, and Arkam Ventures. We make crypto investing simple, safe and accessible for millions of Indians, from first-time investors in tier 2 and 3 cities to experienced traders.

Our B2B infrastructure brand, Saber Money, is building stablecoin-native cross-border payment rails for Asia.

Together, Mudrex and Saber are at the intersection of two significant shifts in global finance: the mainstreaming of digital assets and the transformation of cross-border payments.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Chartered Accountant who can do more than manage numbers. This role is about building and scaling the Finance engine behind a global business.

As part of the Controllership function, you will work across India, the US, Dubai and Canada, partner closely with senior leadership and business teams, and play a key role in transforming how Finance operates at scale.

We’re looking for someone with 5–7 years of relevant experience who can think independently, lead a team, solve complex problems and take initiatives from identification to execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end month-end and year-end financial close process
  • Drive financial and management reporting
  • Oversee balance sheet governance and reconciliations
  • Develop and strengthen accounting policies, controls and compliance processes
  • Coordinate with auditors, tax advisors and regulatory stakeholders
  • Establish and monitor revenue, expense and working capital controls
  • Drive MIS and business reporting
  • Build and improve Finance processes, systems and governance frameworks
  • Lead cross-functional Finance initiatives and process improvement projects
  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, accuracy and scalability of the Finance function

Finance Transformation and Automation

We are building a scalable, technology-enabled Finance function that goes beyond spreadsheets and manual processes.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Operations and Business teams to identify inefficiencies, redesign processes and drive automation.

The role involves owning the complete transformation journey:

Identify the problem → Design the solution → Implement it → Measure the impact

You will be expected to take ownership of this entire process and drive meaningful improvements across the Finance function.

Global Finance Exposure

Experience working across multiple jurisdictions will be an advantage, particularly across:

India | US | Dubai | Canada

The role will provide hands-on exposure to:

  • International entities and cross-border operations
  • Multiple accounting frameworks
  • Tax and regulatory requirements across jurisdictions
  • Auditors and global consultants
  • International Finance processes and controls

What You Can Expect

  • Direct interaction and collaboration with senior leadership
  • An opportunity to build and scale the Controllership function
  • Ownership of Finance transformation and automation initiatives
  • Exposure to multiple international jurisdictions
  • Cross-functional collaboration beyond Finance
  • The opportunity to solve complex and high-impact business problems
  • A high-growth environment where your work will have visible business impact

What We’re Looking For

You are a Chartered Accountant with 5–7 years of relevant experience and strong fundamentals in controllership and accounting.

Beyond technical expertise, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Understands the business behind the numbers
  • Can operate independently and make sound decisions without constant direction
  • Has experience leading, mentoring and developing teams
  • Can take problems from identification through to resolution
  • Has a strong control, process and governance mindset
  • Enjoys building and improving rather than simply maintaining existing processes
  • Is comfortable working with technology and has a strong interest in automation
  • Can effectively influence and collaborate with stakeholders across Finance, Product, Technology, Data and Business teams
  • Maintains high standards of accuracy, integrity and execution

The Mindset We Value

If you see a broken process, you don’t work around it — you fix it.

If something is manual, you ask whether it should be automated.

If the business is growing, you think about how Finance needs to evolve with it.

We’re looking for someone who is comfortable with ownership, ambiguity and building systems that can scale.

The Opportunity

Join Mudrex at a stage where you can have a meaningful impact on how the Finance function is built, scaled and operated across multiple markets.

This is an opportunity to go beyond traditional controllership and contribute to building a modern, technology-enabled Finance function for a global business.

Own the numbers.
Understand the business.
Lead the team.
Drive transformation.
Build for scale.

About Mudrex: Mudrex is India's leading crypto investment platform, backed by Y Combinator, Nexus Venture Partners, and Arkam Ventures. The ideal candidate is someone who combines strong technical expertise with business acumen, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to work cross-functionally.

Key Responsibilities

As a Company Secretary, you will have the opportunity to work across:

  • Corporate Governance & Secretarial Functions – Managing statutory and secretarial compliances, board processes, corporate governance requirements, and related documentation.

  • Legal & Regulatory Affairs – Supporting legal and regulatory matters and coordinating with external legal and compliance advisors.

  • Finance & Corporate Strategy – Working closely with Finance and leadership on corporate structuring, strategic initiatives, and related matters.

  • HR & ESOP Administration – Supporting ESOP-related processes, corporate records, and employee-related corporate compliance.

  • Investor Relations & Fundraising – Supporting fundraising processes, due diligence, investor documentation, and related corporate requirements.

  • Business Operations & Strategic Projects – Contributing to cross-functional projects and initiatives that have a direct impact on the business.

  • Founder’s Office – Working closely with the Founders and Leadership Team on business-critical and strategic priorities.

  • International & Cross-Border Compliance – Supporting compliance and governance requirements across multiple jurisdictions.

You will also work with legal, tax, compliance, and other external advisors, contributing to the development of governance frameworks that enable the business to scale responsibly.

What You’ll Gain

This role offers significant exposure beyond the traditional Company Secretary function, including:

  • Strategic decision-making and working closely with the leadership team

  • Fundraising, due diligence, and corporate restructuring

  • Board and investor interactions

  • Cross-functional business and strategic initiatives

  • International and cross-border legal and compliance frameworks

  • Corporate finance and governance

  • Working with external advisors across multiple jurisdictions

  • An environment that encourages ownership, continuous learning, and problem-solving

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Is a Qualified Company Secretary (ICSI) with 3–5 years of relevant experience.

  • Has strong knowledge of corporate, secretarial, and regulatory compliances.

  • Demonstrates strong drafting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Can work effectively across Legal, Finance, HR, Business, and Leadership teams.

  • Takes ownership and accountability for their work and delivers with a high degree of attention to detail.

  • Is commercially aware and interested in understanding the business beyond their functional role.

  • Is intellectually curious and comfortable taking on responsibilities outside traditional Company Secretary functions.

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving, and high-growth environment.

  • Views governance and compliance as an enabler of sustainable business growth.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to work closely with founders and senior leadership while being involved in real business decisions and strategic initiatives.

If you’re looking to build a career that combines Company Secretarial expertise with broader exposure to business, strategy, finance, legal, and leadership, this role offers the opportunity to do exactly that.

detail_ld.title: Senior Manager, Account Management - Questbank
detail_ld.description:
What’s in it for you as an employee of QFG?

  • Health & wellbeing resources and programs 

  • Paid vacation, personal, and sick days for work-life balance

  • Competitive compensation and benefits packages

  • Work-life balance in a hybrid environment with at least 3 days in office

  • Career growth and development opportunities

  • Opportunities to contribute to community causes

  • Work with diverse team members in an inclusive and collaborative environment

 

This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

 

We’re looking for our next Senior Manager, Account Management. Could It Be You?

The Senior Manager, Account Management is responsible for the performance, strategic direction, and operational risk management of the Account Management function. This leader manages and mentors Managers and, through them, Supervisors and Account Management Specialists, to drive superior client outcomes, achieve key performance metrics, and foster a high-performing, service culture.

This role is accountable for the end-to-end account management lifecycle, including the flawless, compliant execution of high-stakes, high-volume transactions such as account opening, promotions, payments, and account closures. The Senior Manager provides oversight of escalations, partners with Back Office, Treasury, Fraud, Risk, Mortgage Operations, and enterprise technology teams to manage risk and improve tools and processes, and ensures consistent adherence to all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and regulatory standards. 

 

Need more details? Keep reading…

In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to: 

Strategic Leadership & Team Development

  • Shaping and executing our strategy for client experience and account management servicing, translating objectives into team priorities, processes, and measurable targets.

  • Leading, coaching, and mentoring Managers by setting clear goals, giving regular and candid feedback, and holding leaders accountable for team results and the growth of their Supervisors and Specialists.

  • Owning talent and succession planning, including assessments, career conversations, and recruitment, to build a diverse and capable leadership bench.

  • Partnering with Workforce Management on forecasting, staffing, and shift coverage (including evenings, weekends, and statutory holidays) to meet volume demands and SLAs.

 

Client Experience & Escalation Oversight

  • Serving as the executive escalation point for client complaints and complex or sensitive issues, seeing each one through to resolution.

  • Owning service results across phone, live chat, and email, including First Contact Resolution (FCR), CSAT, SLA attainment, Average Wait Time (AWT), Average Handle Time (AHT), and abandon rates.

  • Ensuring disputes and formal complaints are logged, investigated, and resolved in line with regulatory requirements and internal guidelines, and using client insights to improve service across the organization.

 

Operational Oversight & Risk Mitigation

  • Overseeing back-office queues, exceptions, and aged items to ensure completion within SLAs, including reconciliation and investigation of discrepancies.

  • Leading cross-functional collaboration with Back Office, Treasury, Fraud, Risk, and Mortgage Operations to resolve discrepancies proactively and manage systemic risks.

  • Driving operational efficiency through seamless handoffs of complex cases and capacity planning, and working with technology teams to improve tools like Salesforce and Genesys.

 

Compliance, Risk & Continuous Improvement

  • Cultivating and driving a strong risk and compliance culture, ensuring adherence to KYC, AML/ATF, signature standards, and client data privacy requirements.

  • Proactively identifying actual or potential violations and risk situations, ensuring inquiries are completed and corrective actions are taken or escalated in a timely manner.

  • Championing change by working with peers and department heads to improve processes, policies, and procedures, keeping procedure manuals and the knowledge base current.

  • Presenting performance, quality, and trend reports to senior leadership, drawing on industry and market knowledge to inform business planning.

 

So are YOU our next Senior Manager, Account Management - Questbank? You are if you…

  • Have minimum 8-10 years of customer service or operations experience in banking or financial services, ideally within money movement, credit cards, and/or mortgages.

  • Have minimum 5 years of experience developing, leading, and coaching a team of successful professionals and managers.

  • Have a post-secondary degree or diploma in business, finance, economics, or a related field preferred.

  • Have strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate in a professional and knowledgeable manner.

  • Are a self-starter who is results driven, exemplifies the spirit of a team player, and brings a positive, can-do attitude with creative solutions to problems.

  • Are able to build healthy working relationships with team and peers, and to use open communication and collaboration to solve problems and manage deliverables.

  • Work well in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and navigate organizational change.

 

Compensation Information:

  • Base salary range: $125,000 - $135,000

  • The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.

We’re looking for our next Manager, Data Science. Could It Be You?

This role will be responsible for:

The Manager, Data Science leads the vision and technical execution of data science and marketing science across Marketing and Product at Questrade. Operating as a hands-on technical leader, this role spearheads our unified marketing measurement strategy—combining media mix modeling (MMM), incrementality testing, and attribution to determine the commercial impact of brand and performance investments. The Manager designs predictive growth models (such as client lifetime value, propensity, and retention) that directly inform daily business operations, establishes production-grade model standards, and mentors a high-performing data science team while actively writing and reviewing code.

 

Need more details? Keep reading…

In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to: 

  • Data Science Vision & Strategic Roadmap: Define and drive the data science and marketing science vision for Marketing and Product, establishing high technical standards and translating business growth priorities into a scalable modeling roadmap.

  • Comprehensive Marketing Measurement Strategy: Own the end-to-end marketing measurement framework, unifying media mix modeling (MMM), incrementality/geo testing, and multi-touch attribution into a cohesive view to guide capital allocation across brand and performance channels.

  • Client Growth & Predictive Lifecycle Modeling: Architect, build, and deploy high-impact predictive models—including client lifetime value (LTV), cross-sell/upsell propensity, and churn/retention—directly embedding them into day-to-day product and marketing operations.

  • Rigorous Model Governance & Production Standards: Hold all data science products to strict production criteria: ensuring business value is sized upfront, models are systematically validated against holdouts or baseline controls, and pipelines run reliably in production environments.

  • Hands-On Engineering & AI Workflow Adoption: Maintain an active hands-on engineering presence by writing, debugging, and reviewing production Python, SQL, and dbt models (on BigQuery, Databricks, or Snowflake), while utilizing AI coding agents to accelerate delivery with rigorous validation.

  • External Agency & Measurement Vendor Governance: Direct and govern external measurement partners, data vendors, and agency relationships—critically evaluating and pressure-testing their statistical methods, assumptions, and deliverables to ensure integrity.

  • Team Leadership & Statistical Authority: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of data scientists; act as the organization's subject matter expert on causal inference, experimentation design, and statistical rigor for adjacent analysts and cross-functional partners.

  • Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day modeling and coding work, with the judgment to validate their output.

 

So are YOU our next Manager, Data Science? You are if you have…

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Quantitative Marketing, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in data science, marketing science, or advanced analytics, with a proven track record of models directly influencing marketing investments or product growth.

  • Deep practical expertise in media mix modeling (MMM), incrementality testing, geo-testing, multi-touch attribution, causal inference, and client lifetime value (LTV) / propensity modeling.

  • Advanced proficiency in Python for building production machine learning and statistical models; strong SQL and dbt expertise on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Databricks, or Snowflake).

  • Demonstrated experience directing external measurement agencies, vendors, or consulting partners, with the ability to critically pressure-test statistical methodologies.

  • Proven track record of leading, mentoring, and developing data scientists while remaining actively hands-on with modeling and code.

 

Additional kudos if you…

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Statistics, Econometrics, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics).

  • Regular hands-on experience utilizing modern AI coding agents (such as Claude Code) to accelerate model development, coupled with rigorous validation of AI outputs.

  • Experience building a marketing science or data science practice from scratch in a fast-paced or greenfield environment.

  • Prior experience in fintech, digital banking, online brokerage, or regulated customer data environments.

 

Compensation Information:

  • Base salary range: $140,000 - $180,000

  • The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.

We’re looking for our next Senior Software Engineer. Could It Be You?

The Senior Software Engineer leads the technical design and delivery of complex, high-performance features across Questrade's products, spanning front-end applications (React Native, ReactJS) and back-end services (NodeJS, APIs, distributed systems). This role is intentionally platform-flexible: candidates may lean toward front-end, back-end, or full-stack work, with the specific focus determined collaboratively during the interview process based on the candidate's strongest expertise and the team's current needs. The Senior Software Engineer sets engineering standards, mentors developers, partners cross-functionally to ensure scalable and resilient architectures, and owns service or application health for key domain components.



Need more details? Keep reading…

 

In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to: 

  • Lead technical design and delivery of complex features and services — front-end, back-end, or both — documenting architectural trade-offs.

  • Break down large, ambiguous problems into deliverable increments and sequence them with product partners.

  • Set and enforce engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, observability, and operational readiness across the stack.

  • Own performance and scalability across your area — profiling, identifying bottlenecks, and optimizing under production load (for example, high-frequency, real-time data streaming in trading features).

  • Mentor and coach intermediate and junior developers, delivering constructive code reviews and guiding technical growth regardless of specialization.

  • Partner with Product, UX, Enterprise Architecture, and Security to ensure scalable, resilient, and compliant designs across platforms.

  • Lead incident response for significant outages in your area of ownership, driving blameless post-incident reviews to closure with structural fixes.

  • Own health for key domain components — performance, reliability, and technical debt — on the front end, back end, or both.

  • Champion the exploration and adoption of AI tools to improve developer productivity and platform features.

  • Contribute to technical hiring by conducting technical assessments and candidate interviews, including helping calibrate a candidate's front-end/back-end fit.



So are YOU our next Senior Software Engineer ? You are if you…

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 6+ years of experience building, shipping, and operating production software at scale.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of the following tracks, with working familiarity across the stack:

  • Front-end track: Expert-level JavaScript/TypeScript with React Native (mobile) and/or ReactJS (web); strong grasp of state management, component architecture, and cross-platform performance (memory profiling, bundle size, render optimization).

  • Back-end track: Deep expertise in Node.js/TypeScript; proven experience designing distributed systems, APIs, and data models under production load.

  • Proven experience with RESTful APIs and service-oriented or microservices architectures, from either the consuming or the building side.

  • Strong cloud-native experience (GCP preferred), including CI/CD at scale; containerization/Kubernetes exposure is a plus.

  • Demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives across multiple developers without formal authority.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to both engineering and cross-functional audiences.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with real-time data streaming technologies (WebSockets, Kafka, Pub/Sub) or low-latency, high-frequency financial/trading systems.

  • For back-end-leaning candidates: front-end or mobile framework exposure (ReactJS, React Native, iOS/Android) is a strong asset.

  • Angular experience is a nice-to-have.

  • Domain experience in financial services, brokerage, trading, or regulated environments.

  • SRE practices, capacity planning, or cloud cost optimization (FinOps).

  • Experience building AI/ML-enabled features or data-intensive platforms.

  • Active technical thought leadership (open-source contributions, technical publications, conference speaking).

 

Compensation Information:

  • Base salary range: $100,000- $144,000

  • The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.
